body.heading: Make your colour list
paragraphs: Draw boxes on your page and colour each one a different colour: red, blue, green, yellow, purple, brown.
Carry your list and your crayons on your walk.

body.heading: Find each colour
paragraphs: Walk slowly. When you spot something red, make a mark in the red box. A postbox counts. So does a berry bush you only look at.
Some colours are shy. Purple might take the whole walk to find.

takeaway: Colours are hiding everywhere once you start hunting for them.
safetyNotes: Stay with your adult, hold hands near roads, and watch where you walk.
screenFreeExtension: Do a colour hunt in one room at home on a rainy day.
